scripts.validate: bun run build && bun -e "await Bun.file('evals/evals.json').json()" && bun scripts/project-init.mjs list
scripts.build: bash -lc 'tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT; bun build --target=bun scripts/project-init.mjs --outfile "$tmp/project-init.mjs" && bun build --target=bun evals/run-evals.mjs --outfile "$tmp/run-evals.mjs"'
